'''''Shadow Games''''' is a novel by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]] that was released on [[November 29]], [[2011]]. It is a "rags to riches" story of a [[holostar]] during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion's]] early days, taking place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The short story "[[And Leebo Makes Three]]", also written by Reaves and Bohnhoff and published in [[Star Wars Insider 128|''Star Wars Insider'' 128]]<ref name="TERC" /> on [[September 13]], [[2011]],<ref name="Parent release date">[[Star Wars Insider 127|''Star Wars Insider'' 127]]</ref> serves as a prequel to the novel.<ref name="TERC" />
